body:
Support multiple named MLX hosts in config

Currently the `mlx_host` config key stores a single endpoint string:

```
"mlx_host": "192.168.1.100"
```

This limits installations to one local server. Many setups run multiple ports (8000, 8001, 14049, etc.) and prefer named variants rather than hardcoding IPs.

Proposed change:

```json
{
  "mlx_hosts": {
    "host_a": "192.168.1.101:8000",
    "host_b": "192.168.1.102:14049"
  }
}
```

Then models.go can reference `MLX_HOST.A` by key without exposing internal IPs to the public (that's why the config lives in config.json instead of committed settings).

Desired ref: register each named MLX host in `myModels` map (e.g., `mlx_hosts["default"]`), allow `newModel(..., modelWithMlx16(name, port))` to accept a host selector (e.g., `ModelWithMlxHost("host_a")`), then resolve to the actual URL at runtime. 

Also wire it into pricing (`--sort` logic, `modelProvider.String()` checks).
title: Support multiple named MLX hosts in config
